set_aside.subject: judge_execution
set_aside.text: judge_execution: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] When cleanup was confirmed the outcome is the first that holds, in this order of = models.SandboxOutcome: timeout when the deadline passed; resource_exhausted when the report's resource_hit is true — the runner hit its memory, process or scratch limit, the scratch limit being the imported RELEASE_CEILING_SANDBOX_SCRATCH_BYTES_MAX constant, which runner_arguments writes as file_size_limit into the runner's command line and which is no field of ResourceBounds or RunnerLaunch —, the observation's channel_over_bound holds, or the output count exceeds bounds.output_bytes; sandbox_violation when the report holds any trap hit, even if the code caught it and returned a conforming dict; crashed when the report says crashed, the runner exited abnormally, or no returned message was read — the report's returned is None: read_runner_report always gives a RunnerReport, for a channel that carried nothing one with no trap hit, no resource hit, crashed false, failure None and returned None, so the observation always holds a report; contract_violation when the returned value is not a dict with exactly the output ports, an output is not_representable, its JSON text does not give canonical JSON through canonical_bytes, or fit_port_value with bounds.output_bytes as size bound does not fit an output to its port; otherwise succeeded. The stored value and spool ceilings are applied by the module that stores or spools an output.
set_aside.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
set_aside.question: Either restore RELEASE_CEILING_SANDBOX_SCRATCH_BYTES_MAX to the module's IMPORTS and imported data signatures, or remove the note's requirement that this module use that imported constant.
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change
